svg.title: Scoring map
svg.text: Chance a shot scores against a set computer goalie, best aim (Genesis, played in the real game)
Average shooter (working Shot Power 20, Shot Accuracy 15), standing still with the puck; the goalie has set himself. Each square: one spot, 800+ shots per aim.
Units from the goal line at the left. Arrows: the best d-pad direction (dot: nothing held),
shown where it scores 3% or more. Grey: no real shot there (the puck would start within the goalie's reach).
